text:
Maya: Triage - VectorSherpa v0.9 onboarding. FP32 recall@10 (short_seq) 0.748 vs PTQ6(per-tensor) 0.679. Short queries highly affected.
Jun: which short_seq bucket? <=8 tokens?
Maya: yes <=8. Repro: `./eval_embeddings --model vector_sherpa:v0.9 --slice short_seq --metric recall@10`
Rafael: likely per-tensor scaling causing angular bias or PCA/whitening rotation after quant. Did you keep preprocessing identical?
Maya: pipeline identical. Emulated per-channel on proj matrix and saw recall@10 -> 0.715 (partial recovery).
Priya: good. Try 4k calibration (asymmetric) + per-channel only on projection, and a tiny bias-corr (512 samples) on the last linear.
Jun: capture recall@10,@100 and MAP. If recall@100 recovers much, we might accept ptq for cold traffic.
Rafael: add histogram of top-20 cosine sims and principal-angle between top-3 PCA components pre/post quant. If distances compress, knn order is unstable.
Maya: queued runs: ptq6-perchannel+4k-calib, bias-corr512, disable range-fold on final layer. ETA ~1.5h.
ci-bot: run started (id: rs-2026-11-10-09).
Maya: for release notes mark `vector_sherpa/ptq6` as "requires per-channel calibration" and hold canary until short-seq parity. Rafael/Priya will help interpret PCA-angle output.
